verdicts.reason: A has dropped the SOLSTICE wordmark, and the headline and can are shrunk to near-illegible size in the centre. The CTA button text is tiny, and big empty areas sit between the tilted sale ribbon, the headline and the CTA, so the hierarchy is very weak. B keeps the logo and gives the serif headline proper size, reading left to right. Its flaws: the ribbon is crammed under the logo and nearly clipped at the left edge, the tiny can is squeezed between them, and the legal text wraps into three cramped lines under the CTA, right against the right edge.
